profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer (5+ YOE) | React, TypeScript, Node.js | Scalable Web Apps
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer with ~5 years of experience building and scaling production web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS.

At NCR Voyix, I’ve owned and shipped core features for a large-scale restaurant ordering platform used by thousands of merchants, improving page load performance, building reliable REST and GraphQL APIs, and leading features from design through production.

I enjoy working in remote, cross-functional teams, collaborating closely with product and design, and taking ownership of systems end-to-end—from architecture and implementation to deployment and iteration.

Tech: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, NestJS, REST, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, CI/CD
🌍 Open to remote software engineering roles

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Contributed to developing NCR Voyix’s restaurant online ordering web application, leveraging a tech stack that included React.js, Typescript, React Hook Forms, Redux Toolkit, and Material-UI. Spearheaded the creation of multiple crucial screens and seamlessly integrated them with GraphQL API endpoints.

- Proficiently managed code versions using Git. Actively participated in the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes, utilizing GitHub Actions, to streamline the development workflow and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality software.

- Implemented unit testing strategies for React components using the React Testing Library, ensuring code reliability, functionality, and adherence to specifications.

- Developed and maintained automated end-to-end tests with Playwright, enhancing overall test coverage and ensuring a smooth user experience. 

- Designed and implemented multiple GraphQL API endpoints using Nest.js, contributing to the development of a robust and scalable backend infrastructure.

- Active participant in Latin NCR Voyix, contributing to diversity and inclusion initiatives, fostering a collaborative work environment, and enhancing cross-functional communication.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · NestJS · playwright · Jest · Front-End Development · Communication · GraphQL · TypeScript · Version Control

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
- Successfully designed and developed more than 20 custom websites tailored to clients' unique specifications, achieving a 5-star rating and maintaining a 100% customer satisfaction record.

- Effectively managed a diverse portfolio of clients, catering to individuals ranging from musicians to dog walkers, ensuring personalized and impactful web solutions. 

- Utilized HTML 5, CSS, and Bootstrap 4 to create visually appealing and responsive websites that met both aesthetic and functional requirements.

positions.title: RISE Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a dynamic team of IT consulting professionals to develop a sustainable solution addressing a company's significant carbon footprint.

- Crafted a streamlined lean canvas using Microsoft Notes and brought concepts to life through an interactive prototype on Figma. This prototype laid the groundwork for an innovative tool capable of calculating an employee's carbon footprint while offering personalized recommendations for future emission reduction.

- Showcased the project's potential and impact by presenting to both executives at Capgemini and fellow interns, effectively communicating the initiative's value and forward-thinking approach.

positions.title: Snelling Dining Hall: Student Staff
positions.description:
• Trained 10 new employees on preparing food and beverages, restocking food and beverage items, and maintaining a clean and sanitary work area
• Responsible for opening and closing seven assigned stations and communicating customer concerns, needs and equipment malfunctions to management staff
• Assisted cooks and other kitchen personnel in tasks such as washing dishes, serving from a serving line, cleaning tables, and sweeping floors

projects.title: Amazon Clone
projects.description: This Amazon clone was created with HTML, CSS, React.js, Context API, Firebase, and React Router. Features include Firebase user authentication and database for login and shopping cart abilities. This clone is hosted by firebase as well.

projects.title: Bon Apple Tea
projects.description:
Was created to help college students find quick and easy recipes. I worked with a team using HTML/CSS, Bootstrap 4, a Java servlet, JSP, Apache, and SQL. I was responsible for creating the portion of the website that used the database, created the database and connected the
database to the website.

organizations.name: La Unidad Latina,Lambda Upsilon Lambda Fraternity, Inc.
organizations.description:
• Maintain complete and up-to-date copies of the club’s bylaws and other organizational documents
• Collaborate with other members of the executive committee and board of directors to create and execute events to
increase literacy in the Latino community
• Keep a roster of officers and board members with current contact information such as email and social media
